title: A Jaguar Kills by Biting Straight Through a Caiman's Skull

scenes.text: A jaguar kills a crocodile by biting through its skull.
Lions and tigers go for the throat. A jaguar goes for the brain.
It swims out, grabs a caiman from behind, and drives two canines through the skull.
For its size, no big cat bites harder. A 220-pound jaguar bites with over 1,100 pounds of force.
That bite splits a turtle shell open.
And a caiman's brain is the size of a walnut. The jaguar finds it every time.

description:
Jaguars have the strongest bite of any big cat relative to body size, and they use it in a way no other big cat does: they kill by biting through the skull.
Guinness World Records puts the canine bite of a 100-kilogram jaguar at about 500 kilograms of force. Jaguars pull caimans from Brazilian rivers and pierce the back of the head, and the same bite cracks open freshwater turtle shells.
Which cat would win in a fight, a jaguar or a leopard? Comment below.
first_comment: In absolute terms a tiger still bites harder, but pound for pound the jaguar wins. Only about 10,000 jaguars remain in the wild. Which big cat is your favourite?
